why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the MovitOn Loyalty Program Go to the MovitOn rewards site , where the program runs under the line "Complete Tasks > Earn Move Points > Get Airdrop Eligibility".
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Link your wallet through the rewards site. Your points history and rewards are shown only after a wallet is connected and you sign in.

3 Step 3 : Complete tasks to earn Move Points The program runs on the sequence "Complete Tasks > Earn Move Points > Get Airdrop Eligibility". As of 28 October 2026 the rewards site does not list specific tasks.
4 Step 4 : Check your points history Come back to the rewards site to review the points and rewards credited to your wallet.
5 Step 5 : Follow MovitOn for TGE and claim news MovitOn has given no snapshot or claim timing so far. Watch its Telegram channel and X account for announcements.
